research_question: How do modern text-to-image generators create images, and what are their limits?

sources.title: Text-to-image Diffusion Models in Generative AI: A Survey
notes: Reviews text-conditioned image synthesis and the evolution of diffusion methods.
Explains the task as generating images guided by text prompts.
Discusses applications and unresolved challenges in controllability and evaluation.

sources.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
notes: Introduces diffusion probabilistic models for high-quality image synthesis.
The method learns a reverse process that gradually removes noise.
The paper frames generation as a sequence of denoising steps.

sources.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
notes: Moves diffusion into a compressed latent representation to reduce computation.
Uses cross-attention to condition generation on text and other inputs.
Reports image synthesis and editing applications with lower computational requirements than pixel-space diffusion.

sources.title: Photorealistic Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Deep Language Understanding
notes: Describes Imagen, which combines a language model with diffusion image generation.
Shows how text representation and image synthesis jointly affect prompt alignment.
Uses benchmark comparisons to study image quality and text-image alignment.

sources.title: Optimizing image generation pipelines on Google Cloud
sources.reliability: Engineering documentation from a major cloud provider
notes: Diffusion image generation can be computationally demanding.
A typical pipeline may run multiple models in sequence, including encoders, denoisers and decoders.
Runtime and quality depend on model architecture, hardware and data movement.
